content.title: About
content.content: Mixed nuts, without peanuts, unsalted is a blend of selected nuts (almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, walnuts, pine nuts and others) with no added salt and no peanuts. The nuts are rich in healthy fats, protein, vitamins and minerals, making them an excellent snack and ingredient for many dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Nut mixes are often used in cooking to create varied flavors and textures.
The absence of peanuts makes the product safer for people allergic to peanuts, though it still poses a risk for those allergic to other nuts.
The unsalted version preserves the natural taste and nutritional profile of the nuts.
Nuts in the mix can be raw or lightly roasted, depending on the manufacturer.
Mixed nuts are a popular choice for athletes because of their high protein and energy content.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: Nuts contain monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: The blend provides a substantial amount of protein important for tissue repair.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as a powerful antioxidant protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: High in minerals
items.content: Nuts supply magnesium, phosphorus, zinc and iron, essential for many biochemical processes.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: Fiber and protein in nuts help maintain a feeling of fullness longer.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: The mix can trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to any of the included nuts.

items.title: High in calories
items.content: Nuts are calorie-dense, so portion size should be moderated.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Whole nuts may pose a choking risk for young children.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Some nuts (e.g., almonds) contain oxalates, which may contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Unsalted mixed nuts without peanuts are convenient as a standalone snack, added to granola, yogurt, salads, baked goods, or used in sauces. They can be lightly toasted to enhance flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the nuts in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life, keep them in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent fat oxidation. Discard nuts that smell rancid or stale.
